function.description: **NETWORK SERVER SETTINGS** : Retrieve time zone settings for a site. For broad queries such as what network server settings are configured at a site, invoke this tool together with the AAA, DHCP, DNS, image distribution, NTP, and banner settings tools to build a complete network server settings response. Use this tool for generic site-level time zone configuration queries, including the configured time zone identifier, inherited time zone settings, and the parent site from which time zone settings are inherited. Example queries include: What time zone identifier is configured for a site? Is the time zone for a site inherited? From which parent site? `null` values indicate that the setting will be inherited from the parent site; empty objects (`{}`) indicate that the setting is unset at a site.
function.name: api_retrieveTimeZoneSettingsForASite

_inherited.description: Include inherited Time Zone settings from parent sites.

identifier.description: Time zone that corresponds to the site's physical location. The site time zone is used when scheduling device provisioning and updates. Example : GMT
